summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Import History and Revert feature for Bulk Product Upload. All 11 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed for both Admin Dashboard and Vendor Dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Test sessions created during revert tests with unique SKUs (REVERT_TEST_*, STATUS_TEST_*, DOUBLE_REVERT_*, VENDOR_REVERT_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Import History and Revert feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/products/bulk/sessions (list sessions), POST /api/products/bulk/revert/{session_id} (soft-delete products). Revert sets is_active=False on products and changes session status to 'reverted'. Admin login endpoint is /api/admin/auth/login. Vendor login path is /api/vendors/login.
